entities.summary: Hyun Song Shin is a South Korean economic theorist and financial economist who focuses on global games. He has been the Economic Adviser and Head of Research of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) since May 1, 2014. In March 2026, he was nominated to become Governor of the Bank of Korea.
